title: Constraints Determine Output
equation: Max Output = Capacity of the Weakest Constraint
hook: Your slowest part runs the whole show. Not your best one.
statement: Your weakest link is your ceiling.
explainer: Polishing what already works feels productive. It isn't. Fix the bottleneck.
sop: Map your process start to finish.
Attack the lowest one. Ignore the rest.
equation_example: Marketing 9, Sales 8, Fulfillment 3. Your max is 3. Not the average. 3.
question: Name the bottleneck you keep tiptoeing around.
closing_statement: Fix the weak link. Then watch it move.
